messages:
emma-billing: Heads-up: customer Nebula Health (acct: NH-5587) failed ACH setup during onboarding. Payment for invoice 50112 ($12,300) is due tomorrow. Gateway returned 'account_type_mismatch' on microdeposit verification; customer asked if we can accept a one-time wire to avoid service interruption.
alex-payments: Can you paste the raw failure note from the bank? sometimes it's a corporate vs personal account issue or ACH vs EFT mix-up.
emma-billing: Webhook: `status: failed`, `decline_code: account_type_mismatch`, `bank_message: Microdeposit verification not supported for this account type`. Customer support note: "we used business checking, but bank flagged 'non-retail'".
ops-oncall: If it's business vs retail, Plaid instant verification might also fail. Ops: pause autopay retries while we wait for wire.
nora-finance: Quick QA: 1) Is autopay enabled? 2) Any prior disputed invoices? If autopay on and no disputes, manual wire ok but needs VP approval + audit note.
emma-billing: Autopay enabled and currently failing. No disputes in ledger. Customer rep says treasury can remit wire today if we send instructions and a pro-forma showing invoice details for their payments team.
billing-bot: Payment attempt recorded 2026-12-07 09:18 UTC (txn: pay_f3d2). Status: failed. Retry scheduled per policy.
alex-payments: I'm fine approving a wire for <$50k. @cecilia-vpfinance can you confirm? Also request a signed one-off billing addendum from customer for our records.
cecilia-vpfinance: Approved. Accept wire for invoice 50112 ($12,300). Requirements: (1) remittance email to billing@redwood.ai with bank reference; (2) upload of the wire confirmation to billing folder; (3) no changes to contract terms. Proceed.
emma-billing: Sending wiring instructions + pro-forma now. Please pause autopay retries for NH-5587 until we confirm receipt.
emma-billing: Wire instructions to customer (text sent):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: First Coast Bank
Routing (ABA): 021000021
Account: 1122334455
SWIFT: FCBKUS33
Reference: Invoice 50112 - NH-5587
Remittance email: billing@redwood.ai
Note: Please attach a copy of the bank trace/reference when you send the remittance email.
```
Customer asked for pro-forma PDF for their treasury team; I've attached it to the outbound email.
ops-oncall: Confirmed: support will pause autopay retries for NH-5587 and add a note to avoid duplicate charges.
emma-billing: Customer replied: "Wire work in progress, should hit in 1-2 business days. Will send reference once done."
alex-payments: After funds post, we'll mark invoice paid and cancel pending retries. Emma: upload signed addendum and the remittance email to the audit folder.
emma-billing: Will do. Checklist: signed addendum (pending), remittance email (pending), ledger reconciliation after post.
billing-bot: Flag created: MANUAL_SETTLEMENT-9123. Please attach docs for audit trail.
nora-finance: Thanks team 389 once the bank posts I'll reconcile and close the ticket."
